title_en: The sign of Christ’s presence: dated features since 1914
description_en: Features of the composite sign of Jesus’ presence and of “the last days” (Matthew 24, Luke 21, Revelation 6) that Watchtower and Awake! articles illustrate with dated events: World War I and World War II, the Spanish influenza of 1918, famines in 1921, 1933, and 1943, and reports of the worldwide Kingdom preaching. Jesus’ prophecy is anchored to the day he gave the sign (Nisan 11, 33 C.E.) and Revelation to its writing (c. 96 C.E.).
description_ta: இயேசு ஓர் அடையாளத்தைக் கொடுத்தார். அந்த அடையாளத்தில் ஏராளமான அம்சங்கள் அடங்கியிருந்தன; அவையெல்லாம் ஒட்டுமொத்தமாகச் சேர்ந்ததே, இயேசுவின் பிரசன்னம் ஆரம்பமாகிவிட்டதற்கான அடையாளம் அல்லது அறிகுறி ஆகும்.

sources.title_en: Do You Recognize the Sign of Jesus’ Presence?
sources.quote_en: This sign is composed of several facets, which together make up a composite identifying mark, or signal​—the sign of Jesus’ presence.

sources.title_en: The True Culprit Behind War and Suffering
sources.quote_en: Jesus Christ foretold a time when ‘nation would rise against nation’ and food shortages and pestilences would sweep through the earth. (Matthew 24:3, 7; Luke 21:10, 11) He told his disciples that such calamities would form a sign of the last days.

sources.title_en: The Bible—A Book of Accurate Prophecy, Part 6
sources.quote_en: the Bible describes a pattern of events and attitudes, or a sign, that would occur during a time period called “the last days.” (2 Timothy 3:1)

sources.title_en: What Is the Sign of “the Last Days,” or “End Times”?
sources.quote_en: World conditions as well as Bible chronology indicate that the last days began in 1914, the year World War I began.

notes: Only features that jw.org illustrates with a dated event are members. Earthquakes (Luke 21:11; w05 10/1: an average of 18 destructive quakes a year “since 1914”), the attitudes of 2 Timothy 3:1-5, and Matthew 24:10, 12 are described with statistics or general statements, not dated events, so they are not members. Jesus’ prophecy (b5-0144) and Revelation (b11-0067) appear once per feature group.
